card.name: Linking words before audio and acoustics terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, and, with, against, add, in) just before an expected sound or audio term such as hearing aids, compression, delay or noise level. Seen in acoustics, classroom noise, music production and orchestration text.

card.writes: It nudges the next word toward sound-related terms such as cond, wind and compressor, and away from words starting with viol.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words when the text is about sound, hearing or audio effects and a sound term is expected next.
